exposure: Infants with maternal infection onset before 2 weeks before delivery
Maternal infection onset before 2 weeks before delivery
Maternal infection onset within 2 weeks before delivery
cohort: Infants born to mothers with SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy.
finding: Infants born to mothers with SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy did not experience adverse clinical outcomes, and maternal antibody levels decreased in infants, with most seronegative by 6 months of age.
mod_finding: Rates of preterm and Cesarean delivery were comparable between women with and without infection (6% vs 8%, P = .57; 22% vs 32%, P = .06).
